description: This file is a shell script used for configuring router functionalities such as managing hostapd interfaces, restarting wireless access points, configuring network interfaces, setting DHCP and bridge configurations, and starting related services on a network device.

methods.name: Restart_Hostapd
methods.description: Restarts the hostapd service for the 2.4GHz interface by bringing it down, killing existing processes, and starting it again.

methods.name: Restart_Hostapd_5G
methods.description: Restarts the hostapd service for the 5GHz interface by removing and reloading kernel modules and starting hostapd with the specified configuration.

methods.name: Hostapd_Restart
methods.description: Restarts the hostapd service for the primary interface, ensuring it is running.
